About UniUni
UniUni, a North American leader in last-mile logistics, delivers tens of millions of parcels annually in Canada, from Coast to Coast, and is rapidly expanding across the United States. Founded in 2019, UniUni’s tech-driven innovation and crowdsourcing delivery model offers fast, economical, and reliable services to local, national, and international e-commerce clients.
About The Role
At UniUni, we offer exciting opportunities to our employees to achieve their career goals. We value lateral moves as much as vertical promotions – we believe all roles should develop your skills, broaden your experience, and help you build a rewarding career. We know you are not only seeking a job, but a career to pursue. If you are ready to join UniUni’s dynamic team, while working hard and having fun doing it, we invite you to apply online and let us know how you can be part of our success story
What You'll Do
Act as the subject-matter expert for EHS compliance within warehouse operations. Understand and be able to interpret OSHA and other health and safety related regulations.
Implement warehouse EHS policies and procedures aligned across the region.
Conduct incident investigations and root-cause analysis, create and implement corrective and preventive actions to avoid recurrence. Follow record keeping requirements.
Conduct risk assessments related to jobs performed and new equipment, recommend appropriate risk mitigation measures to management
Perform OSHA compliance audits and EHS inspections.
Deliver safety training programs (e.g., forklift, ergonomics, PPE, fire drills). Coaching employees on observed unsafe behavior
Maintain and analyze safety performance metrics (incident rate, lost time, near misses).
Interface with external inspectors and insurance departments along with OSHA and other regulatory agencies.
Promote a positive safety culture and safe behavior while complying with Uniuni EHS requirements and maintaining a safety work environment.
Qualifications
OSHA 30-Hour Certification preferred
1–2 years of experience in warehouse environment or in safety, EHS fields.
Must be self-motivated and able to work independently.
Must be able to travel up to 50% of work time.
Strong hands-on skills and operational understanding of warehouse safety practices.
Demonstrated consistency in delivering safety programs and results.
Able to keep accurate and detailed injury and illness prevention and health and safety inspection records by following OSHA record keeping requirements
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, including with operations, HR, compliance, and insurance departments.
Excellent communication, training, and analytical skills.
Excellent personal engagement skills and able to work with employees of different levels and with different education background.

About UniUni
Who Are We?
UniUni, a North American leader in last-mile logistics, delivers tens of millions of parcels annually in Canada, from Coast to Coast, and is rapidly expanding across the United States. Founded in 2019, UniUni’s tech-driven innovation and crowdsourcing delivery model offers fast, economical, and reliable services to local, national, and international e-commerce clients.
What Do We Offer?
At UniUni, we offer exciting opportunities to our employees to achieve their career goals. We value lateral moves as much as vertical promotions – we believe all roles should develop your skills, broaden your experience, and help you build a rewarding career. We know you are not only seeking a job, but a career to pursue. If you are ready to join UniUni’s dynamic team, while working hard and having fun doing it, we invite you to apply online and let us know how you can be part of our success story.
Compensation: $19.00 – $23.00 / hour (DOE - Depending on Experience)
Core Responsibilities
DSP & Driver Management
Coordinate daily with DSPs and drivers to ensure attendance, route readiness, and compliance.
Verify driver check-in, route assignment, and departure timelines.
Monitor driver performance, POD compliance, and communication quality.
Escalate service or behavioral issues to Hub Manager as needed.
Morning Dispatch Execution
Prepare and release daily routes according to volume and cutoff time.
Confirm route allocation accuracy and system alignment before driver departure.
Conduct dispatch briefing for drivers (special notes, weather, backlog, service reminders).
Ensure all scanners/devices are functioning prior to route launch.
Redelivery Assignment & Service Recovery
Review failed delivery cases and assign redelivery routes accordingly.
Coordinate with DSPs to ensure next-day redelivery completion.
Monitor aging packages and prevent backlog accumulation.
Track repeat failure addresses and escalate recurring issues.
Address Correction & Data Accuracy
Review incorrect or incomplete addresses in the system.
Conduct address verification and update system records timely.
Communicate corrected information to drivers and DSP teams.
Reduce delivery failure caused by zipcode or input errors.
Exception Package Handling
Identify and categorize exception packages (damaged, missing, customer unavailable, restricted access, etc.).
Investigate root causes and document findings.
Coordinate with warehouse team for package location and status verification.
Ensure proper system update and status accuracy for all exceptions.
Communication & Coordination
Maintain real-time communication between dispatch, DSPs, warehouse, and management.
Provide daily dispatch and exception summary report.
Support operational improvement initiatives to enhance dispatch efficiency and reduce cost.
Qualifications
Experience in logistics, last-mile operations, or dispatch coordination preferred.
Familiar with DSP model and driver performance management.
Strong problem-solving and multitasking ability in fast-paced environment.
Proficient in Excel and dispatch systems.
Bilingual (English/Chinese/Spanish) preferred.
